name: Aeon, Zenith, Psionic
body:
Aeon, Zenith, Psionic
CR 30/MR 10

XP 9,830,400
N Fine outsider (extraplanar, incorporeal, mythic, swarm)
Init +25/+5M, dual initiative MA; Senses aura sight, darkvision 60 ft., pierce the veils, touchsight 100 ft.; Perception +46; Aura harmony 300 ft. (DC 37)

DEFENSE

AC 42, touch 42, flat-footed 31 (+13 deflection, +11 Dex, +8 size)
hp 735 (31d10+565); regeneration 30 (deific or Mythic)
Fort +25, Ref +21, Will +27
DR 10/epic; Immune cold, critical hits, incorporeal traits, poison, swarm traits; Resist acid 30, electricity 30, fire 30, sonic 30; PR 41

OFFENSE

Speed fly 200 ft. (perfect)
Melee swarm (20d6 force damage plus subsume)
Space 60 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks lore of a million worlds, mythic power (unlimited, surge +1d12), overmind abilities, subsume
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 25th; concentration +38)

Constant—aura sight, piece the veils, slip the bonds
At will—dispel psionics, hypercognitionM, metaconcert *, metafaculty M
3/day—cosmic blessingM, reality revisionM

Typical Psion Powers Known (ML 25th; power points: 493; base save DC 25 + power level; concentration +40)

Talents-detect psionics, far hand, unearthly terror
1st-astral constructM, beckoning, control object, energy ray, environment shield
2nd-holographic projection, object reading, psychic bodyguard, sensitivity to psychic impressions
3rd-battlesense, floral alteration, psionic blast, short circuit
4th-quintessence, remote viewing, schism, wrench
5th-adapt body, complex false sensory input, energy current, mind probe
6th-greater modify matterM, temporal accelerationM, terraforming
7th-cosmic perspective, ecological alteration, personal barred mind
8th-energy pillars, feed to oblivion, greater psychoport M
9th-affinity fieldM, psychic chirurgeryM, time regressionM, timeless bodyM, true creationM, unravel psionics M (powers do not include the +2 DC bonus from Greater Psionic Endowment)

STATISTICS

Str —, Dex 33, Con 41, Int 40, Wis 35, Cha 36
Base Atk +31; CMB +23; CMD 56
Feats Boost Construct, Deep FocusM, Endowed Mind, Greater Power Penetration, Greater Psionic Endowment, Hustle Power, Improved Initiative M, Malleable Power, Mythic Paragon M, Mythic Powers Known M, OverchannelM, Persistent Power, Power Penetration, Psionic Endowment, Psionic Meditation, Quicken Power, Selective Power, Talented Skills Autohypnosis +46, Appraise +46, Craft (any one) +49, Diplomacy +47, Knowledge (all) +63, Heal +43, Perception +46, Sense Motive +46, Spellcraft +49, Stealth +53, Survival +43, Use Magic Device +44
Languages envisaging
SQ extension of all, greater starflight

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aura of Harmony (Su)

Any creature within 300 feet of a zenith is put at ease by the vastness and scintillating glory of the entity. All creatures must succeed at a DC 37 Will save or become fascinated so long as they remain within the aura. For every 10 rounds that the creature spends inside this aura, its alignment moves one step closer to true neutral (this is considered a willing change). If a true neutral creature remains fascinated for more than 5 rounds, the zenith may deal its swarm damage to the target as a free action (which does not interfere with the fascination effect). The save DC is Charisma-based.

Greater Starflight (Ex)

A zenith flies through outer space at incredible speeds. Although the exact travel time will vary from one trip to the next, a trip within a solar system normally takes a zenith 2d6 hours, and a trip beyond normally takes 2d6 days (or more, at the GM’s discretion).

Lore of a Million Worlds (Su)

A zenith possesses knowledge of every power ever created on any power list but cannot know all of them at once. It can readily manifest 36 powers and 3 talents at any given time and can exchange them for other powers whenever it restores its power points. A zenith can also exchange its feats and skills every time it does this. A zenith requires no components of any kind for manifesting powers. In addition, a zenith is treated as having unlimited uses of mythic power per day. In addition, the zenith may target itself with powers as if it did not possess the swarm subtype.

Overmind Abilities (Su)

A zenith possesses the Mythic Manifestation ability of an Overmind, as well as the following Overmind Path Abilities: Bypass Mental Defenses, Calming Presence, Dual Energy, Mighty Construct, Penetrating Energy, Psionic Metamastery x3, Psionic Breach, Ravaging Time, and Swap Power Known .

Subsume (Su)

Any intelligent creature reduced to 0 hit points by the zenith’s Swarm Attack must succeed at a DC 39 WIll save or be subsumed into the zenith, entering into the shared consciousness of millions of transcendent entities. Creatures destroyed in this way can be restored to life only through miracle, true resurrection, wish, or divine intervention. The save DC is Constitution-based.
